description.en: Finds the cover picture of a video game for everything about games on your site. Your free RAWG key is entered once, here, and never shown again. If a cover is the wrong one, a simple screen lets you pick the right game, and your choice is remembered.
description.fr: Trouve la jaquette d'un jeu vidéo pour tout ce qui parle de jeux sur votre site. Votre clé RAWG gratuite se saisit une seule fois, ici, et n'est jamais réaffichée. Quand une jaquette n'est pas la bonne, un écran très simple permet de choisir le bon jeu, et votre choix est retenu.

privacy.en: This module collects nothing about your visitors. The covers come from RAWG (rawg.io), a video-game database: your site's server sends it the game title with your RAWG key. Found covers are kept privately on your site (1,000 at most): the title, the game name and the picture address, never a picture file. The browser loads each picture from RAWG, which therefore sees the person's address under its own privacy policy.
privacy.fr: Ce module ne collecte rien sur votre public. Les jaquettes viennent de RAWG (rawg.io), une base de jeux vidéo : le serveur de votre site lui envoie le titre du jeu, avec votre clé RAWG. Les jaquettes trouvées sont gardées en privé sur votre site (1 000 au plus) : le titre, le nom du jeu et l'adresse de l'image, jamais un fichier. Le navigateur charge chaque image depuis RAWG, qui voit donc l'adresse de la personne selon sa propre politique de confidentialité.

mcp.name: rawg_covers_to_check
mcp.description: Lists the game titles whose cover is doubtful (the game RAWG gave is not an almost identical title, or two games looked as good), the 100 most recent first. Each has: title (as asked by a module), foundGame, rawgId, coverUrl, candidates (how many games RAWG proposed) and checkedAt. Pass "title" to also get up to 6 candidate games to choose from (rawgId, name, year, platforms, coverUrl); it asks RAWG once. The owner fixes titles in the Game covers module; with the right to, you can use rawg_cover_set. No key is ever shown.

title.description: Optional. A title from the list (or any title): also returns up to 6 candidate games from RAWG with their rawgId, year and main platforms.

search.description: Optional, with title: other words to look for at RAWG (for example the game's real name).

mcp.name: rawg_covers_list
mcp.description: Lists the covers the module keeps, newest first: the ones the owner corrected (origin "corrected"), the games left without a cover ("none") and the covers the site found by itself ("auto", at most 1000 kept, doubtful or not). Each has: title, origin, game (name, may be empty), coverUrl (an https://media.rawg.io/media/... picture, or null) and at. Optional filters: "search" (words of the title) and "origin"; 50 per call by default (100 at most), with "total" for the whole list. Nothing is changed and no key is ever shown. To change or forget one, ask the owner, or use rawg_cover_set with their consent.

search.description: Optional. Words of the game title to look for.

origin.description: Optional. Only the covers corrected by the owner, left without a cover, or chosen automatically.

limit.description: Optional. How many to return (50 by default).

mcp.name: rawg_cover_set
mcp.description: Saves the right cover for one game title, for the whole site (modules get it at once). Pass "title" and exactly ONE of: rawgId (the right game, chosen among the candidates of rawg_covers_to_check), none=true (no cover for this title), imageUrl (an https://media.rawg.io/media/... picture), forget=true (remove the saved correction). The cover comes from RAWG's own answer; no other address is ever used. At most 1000 corrections are kept. Changes the pictures visitors see: ask the owner before using it.

title.description: The title as modules ask for it (as shown by rawg_covers_to_check).

rawgId.description: The RAWG id of the right game, taken from the candidates of rawg_covers_to_check.

search.description: Optional, with rawgId: the words used to find the candidates (when you listed them with a different search).

none.description: true: this title gets no cover at all.

imageUrl.description: An https://media.rawg.io/media/... picture chosen by the owner. No other address is accepted.

forget.description: true: forget the saved correction of this title (the automatic choice comes back).
